messages:
maya (ml-intake): Heads up — team wants to try onboard 'aurora-3B' (open checkpoint from community repo) for a latency-sensitive summarization proof-of-concept. Need license / export checks before we do any hosted evals. TL;DR: possible non-commercial clause?

license-bot: auto-scan results: repository: github.com/aurora-ai/aurora-3b
 - detected license file: LICENSE.txt
 - flagged: 'Aurora-3B License v1.0' (custom). Potential restrictions: non-commercial term, attribution required, no-derivatives uncertain. Please consult legal.

daniel (legal): Can you paste the LICENSE.txt link? Custom licenses are always tricky. If it has an NC clause we can't offer as hosted product. We can run internal evals if team signs an internal use addendum but export controls still apply.

maya (ml-intake): link: https://github.com/aurora-ai/aurora-3b/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
Excerpt: "Use permitted for research and non-commercial purposes only. Redistribution or commercial use prohibited without written consent."

raj (ml-eval): For context, we're looking at 3B model to compare quantized performance (q4 vs int8) vs saffron7b baseline for latency/cost. Only plan: internal evals + microbenchmarks, no customer traffic.

daniel (legal): Okay that excerpt sounds like NC. That means:
 - No hosted offering (Redwood Hosted) or enabling customers to use it commercially.
 - Private/Dedicated usage by a customer? If customer supplies the model and accepts risk maybe, but we can't ship it as part of our model catalog.
 - Internal eval by employees for research/prototyping is usually fine but keep artifacts internal. No distributing derivatives.

sophia (security): Note: custom model may require vetting for hidden telemetry or trojans. Can the team run containerized inference in a locked down environment? Recommend restricted VPC and no outbound at eval time. Also avoid uploading model weights to third-party storage.

maya (ml-intake): We'll do local-only weights on eng-dedicated GPU nodes. No uploads. For quantization experiments: plan to run scripts: 
```
python quantize.py --model ./weights --format q4_0 --benchmark microbench.json
```
Anyone object?

raj (ml-eval): Sounds good. Also want to run the standard regression eval suite (toxicity, randomness tests, rouge/bleu on prompt sets). If we see quality regression vs saffron7b > 4% on summarization metric, we stop. I'll log results to internal eval dashboard only.

olivia (prod): Quick reminder: label this clearly in our tracker as "NC-licensed model — internal only" so product doesn't accidentally include it in examples or quickstarts. Also block rollout pipelines to Hosted.

license-bot: note added to repo: issue #license-scan-1799004321 created. Risk: NC. Action: legal review required for any broader use.

daniel (legal): Next steps from legal:
 1) I will request the model lineage + training data provenance document from the upstream authors. If data has restricted sources (e.g., proprietary third-party corpora) that could trigger additional obligations.
 2) We'll propose an internal-use agreement template if team needs longer-term access.
 3) If the upstream grants a separate commercial license, we can re-evaluate hosting.

maya (ml-intake): Timeline: raj+team will run quantization + evals this week in restricted env. Daniel — pinging you Monday for lineage doc. Sophia — I will coordinate locked VPC. Olivia — will tag tracker entry 'nc_internal'.

sophia (security): Approve restricted env plan. Also add a step: checksum model file before and after quantization to ensure no exfiltration via model artifact tampering.

raj (ml-eval): Will include SHA256 checksums and save to internal-only logs. If we want, I can run a quick adversarial prompt set to detect memorized PII — circle back if hits.

daniel (legal): Sounds good. For audit trail, record: who had access, where weights stored, and ACLs. No external sharing. If anyone wants to demo results externally we need written permission.

maya (ml-intake): Great. Target: internal report by Fri. If legal finds anything else, we'll pause. Thanks all :thumbsup:

olivia (prod): Also add a product flag: "no-hosted, no-catalog" in model intake form. I'll update the intake ticket.

license-bot: thread closed for automated actions. Manual follow-up required.
